mia.gtm: Need a compact battlecard snippet and 3 AE rebuttals for launch. Keep it punchy.

cedric.ae: Buyers ask: "Why not use cloud endpoints?" Short rebuttal please.

leo.content: Rebuttal draft: 'Cloud endpoints are quick to start but can hide per-token costs and show tail latency under burst. Redwood gives predictable unit economics and routing controls.'

anya.prod: Add a technical line: 'Model-variant fallbacks and KV-cache keep p95 bounded during regional pressure.'

bench-bot: internal-sample: public_api p50=200ms p95=520ms; redwood_dedicated p50=90ms p95=260ms; cost example: public $0.027/1k vs dedicated $0.012/1k. (internal only)

mia.gtm: Webinar hooks (3): 1) 'How routing + cache cuts unit cost without breaking SLAs' 2) 'Demo: surviving region-wide bursts' 3) 'Rollouts that don't require a months-long ops project'

cedric.ae: AE snip (email opener): 'Hi — quick note: teams often realize up to 60% lower per-token cost while keeping demo latency in the 100–200ms band. Can I share a short teardown?'

mia.gtm: Nice. Action: leo to finalize 1-paragraph battlecard, anya to attach bench methodology, cedric to test AE lines with two reps. Legal flag: avoid absolutes, use 'up to' and 'typical'.

bench-bot: compliance: do not publish raw internal cost numbers without approvals.
